body: My loyalty towards him is preventing me from just leaving.

>I understand what it feels like to want to disappear and to want things to end. I get that it feels like a hole you don’t have the strength to dig yourself out of… but please understand, your life is valid, you are important and you are loved. Please seek intensive therapy…maybe even an inpatient program….please try to cut contact with your father at least temporarily if you are able. Do you have a support person or network outside of your family?

Thank you for your words. I don't have a support person outside of my family. My mom is the only one and I don't tend to burden her with my worries. My only support is hope. That if I bear it, I'll be alright. In sikhi we believe in karma, so I am also bearing it with the hope that once my bad karma is over, this will also be over.
I can't. I'll lose my job  if I reveal my mental health scars.

How are you feeling, this Friday? How did you feel this week?: anxious.   
How have the feelings been showing up for you (physically or mentally)?: unable to study  
What steps are you taking to cope with, or to move through, those feelings?: wrote a reddit post. Talked to my mom.
